title: docs(tests): replace a false `typecheck`-script premise in four pin headers
body:
Fixes #16742

Four test files justified a pin's placement (or a typing choice) with the claim that the
package "has no `typecheck` script (a type-check DEBT ledger entry)". Both halves are false
on this tree. This is comment prose only — every changed line begins with `//`, proved
mechanically:

```
git diff -U0 | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' \
  | grep -vE '^[+-][[:space:]]*//' | grep -vE '^[+-][[:space:]]*$'
  -> no output
```

## The falsification, re-derived rather than transcribed

`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`'s `DEBT` object literal (lines 802-830 on this tree)
holds exactly four entries, and they are other packages: `@objectstack/cloud-connection`,
`@objectstack/hono`, `@objectstack/observability`, `@objectstack/spec-monorepo`. The
`DEBT['@objectstack/service-storage']` that appears elsewhere in the same file is past-tense
prose about an entry #15050 deleted, not a fifth entry. `TEST_DEBT` holds exactly one:
`@objectstack/http-conformance`. `check:type-check-debt` printed the same population
independently: "76/80 workspace packages type-checked (plus the root), 4 in the DEBT ledger".

Each named package declares a `typecheck` script, read out of its own `package.json`:

```
@objectstack/core                     tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.examples.json && pnpm check:test-typecheck
@objectstack/runtime                  tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck
@objectstack/service-automation       tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck
```

## Finding the carriers — a grep cannot, and a count is not a reading

The sentence contains backticks, wraps across lines, and the `// ` prefix lands inside the
wrap. The scan strips comment prefixes, flattens whitespace, drops backticks, then matches the
short fragment `has no typecheck script` over all 7969 tracked source/doc files. Positive
control `DEBT` -> 744 hits; nonsense control -> 0.

Seven files carry the fragment, six of them test files, and the count is identical (1) before
and after this change — which is exactly why the count decides nothing. Each was read:

| file | before | in scope |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/rest/src/plugin-type-closed-set.pin.test.ts` | quoted and corrected by #16738 | no |
| `packages/core/src/plugin-type-closed-set.test.ts` | quoted and corrected by #16738 | no |
| `packages/rest/src/plugin-metadata-retired-fields.pin.test.ts` | **asserted** as live justification | yes |
| `packages/core/src/plugin-loader.retired-fields.pin.test.ts` | **asserted** as live justification | yes |
| `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.test.ts` | **asserted** as live justification | yes |
| `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-trigger-kind-shared-resolver.test.ts` | **asserted** as live justification | yes |
| `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` | a true general statement about DEBT graduates | no |

All four asserted carriers are now quoted-and-corrected, following the pattern #16738 set:
delete the false premise, promote the surviving true reason, record the correction in place.

## The promoted reasons

**rest / core retired-fields pair.** The compile-time pin lives in `rest` because only that
program resolves `@objectstack/core` to the BUILT `dist/index.d.ts`. Re-proved here with
`tsc --noEmit --listFiles` on both programs, workspace closure built first, each leg carrying
its own control:

```
packages/rest/tsconfig.test.json      packages/core/dist/index.d.ts present · 0 files under packages/core/src/
                                      control: 213 of rest's own src files in the program · nonsense path 0
packages/core/tsconfig.test.json      packages/core/src/plugin-loader.ts present · 0 files under packages/core/dist/
                                      control: 120 of core's own src files in the program · nonsense path 0
```

`PluginMetadata` is declared at `packages/core/src/plugin-loader.ts:41`, so a directive in core
would be evaluated — core's `typecheck` names its own `tsconfig.test.json` since #14613 — but
against the source declaration, never the emitted surface. That is the durable half; the
script-list half was not.

**runtime — the quickjs `ctx.crypto` pin.** Derived from this package's own wiring, not copied.
`packages/runtime/tsconfig.json` is the BUILD config and excludes `**/*.test.ts` (measured: 0 of
its test files in that program, 81 non-test src files as the control), which is where the old
sentence came from. But #14504 added `tsconfig.test.json`, which the `typecheck` script NAMES
via `check:test-typecheck --project`, and `tsc --listFiles` puts
`src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.test.ts` in it. So a type-level directive there would be live. The
real reason the pin is executable is the defect it pins: `ScriptContext.crypto.hash` was
DECLARED on the host seam and never installed, so a type-level assertion reads the very artefact
that lied and would have passed green on the broken tree. Only running the sandbox observes what
the VM really got.

**service-automation — the `FlowTrigger` typing note.** Derived the same way. That package's
`tsconfig.json` carries no test exclusion (its `include` is `["src"]`), so the `tsc --noEmit`
its `typecheck` script runs already compiles the file, and #15048's `tsconfig.test.json`
compiles it too (measured: the file is in both programs; 127 own test files in each). There is
no `test-typecheck-debt.json` beside that config, and the gate confirms the absence is the zero:
"0 file(s) / 0 error(s) / 0 pinned signature(s)". The floor under that file is stricter than the
old sentence claimed, not laxer.

## Changeset: `skip-changeset`, measured

The four files sit under `packages/**/src/**`, so this was measured rather than assumed. The
criterion is whether anything a package actually ships moves. Each package's `files` is
`["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`; after a full workspace build, a token unique to each
edited test file was grepped across exactly those shipped paths, with a positive control from
the same package's own source in the same pass:

```
packages/rest                   'retired-configschema-pin'                    0 files   control 'RestServer'            6
packages/core                   'live-sibling-control'                        0 files   control 'PluginMetadata'        5
packages/runtime                'the VM ctx.crypto exposes exactly randomUUID' 0 files  control 'installCtx'            5
packages/services/service-automation 'flowWith'                               0 files   control 'resolveTriggerBinding' 5
```

Zero hits with the control hitting means the grep reached the shipped bytes and the comment
prose is not among them — a bundled package emits nothing from `src/**/*.test.ts`.
`check:published-files` is green on the same tree. Nothing publishable moves, so this PR
declares no release of its own.

## Verification, at `b20d479d76`

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: **55 derived families, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.**
- Two of the 55 first returned **exit 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET, which is neither green nor red**:
  `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` both need the whole workspace built.
  The full build was run (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'`,
  72/72 tasks) and both were driven to a real verdict: **exit 0**.
- `pnpm typecheck` for the four affected packages: all **exit 0**. The two test-layer ledgers
  are unmoved — runtime "27 file(s) / 191 error(s) / 69 pinned signature(s)", service-automation
  "0 / 0 / 0". The ledger is keyed by file plus normalised signature, not by line number, so
  inserting comment lines above an existing diagnostic cannot move it.
- The four edited test files run: rest 2 passed, core 3 passed, runtime 63 passed,
  service-automation 14 passed.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) over the whole repo: **exit 0**. No narrowing, so
  no narrowing claim is being made.
- Control-byte self-scan over the four files: no hits, with a firing control on the same
  instrument.

## Acceptance notes

- **A fifth asserted carrier exists, in a wording the card's fragment does not match, and it is
  deliberately NOT touched here.** `packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin-slot-lookups.test.ts`
  says "`packages/rest/tsconfig.json` excludes its `.test.ts` files and the package declares no
  `typecheck` script (it is a DEBT/TEST_DEBT ledger entry), so NO tsc program compiles this
  file". `@objectstack/rest` declares `tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`, is in neither
  ledger, and its `tsconfig.test.json` program compiles that file. It was found by widening the
  scan to wording variants (`no typecheck script`, `DEBT ledger entry`, `DEBT table of`,
  `type-check DEBT lane`) rather than the single fragment. Reported to the dispatching seat
  rather than folded in, per the dispatch's explicit fence.
- Checked and NOT carriers, so that the next scan does not re-open them:
  `plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.test.ts` (already quoted-and-corrected by
  #13176), `service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-driver-handle-contract.test.ts` (claims
  absence from the ledger, which is true), `verify/src/harness.host-resolution.test.ts` (claims
  a TEST_DEBT entry for a different package), and `spec/src/contracts/objectql-engine.ts`
  (past-tense history of why #4311 happened, not a live justification).
- The six-versus-five counting difference the card asked to reconcile: the fragment occurs in
  seven files on this tree, six of them test files. The seventh,
  `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, states it generically about DEBT graduates and is
  true. Two of the six were already fixed, so four were in scope — the arithmetic the card
  states.
